title: Musculoskeletal Pain in Long-term Dizziness
brief_summary: This project is aimed at patients with dizziness believed to be due to conditions in the balance organ in the inner ear (vestibular diseases). Dizziness can be bothersome and influence postural control negatively, and can cause secondary musculoskeletal disorders. Dizziness can also result in reduced work capacity. The purpose of the project is to strengthen the knowledge base regarding symptom burden, prognosis and treatment of prolonged dizziness. The hypothesis is that musculoskeletal pain at baseline is a prognostic factor for prolonged dizziness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients referred to an otorhinolaryngological university clinic due to suspected vestibular disorders (dizziness)
* Patients must be bothered with dizziness at the time of consultation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients uable to fill in questionnaires due language barriers
* Patients not able to undergo diagnostic and testing procedures
* Patients with vestibular Schwannoma
* Patients with diving-related inner ear injuries
